text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: wrote scripts/disburse_cycle2.py — loads active households, checks eligibility via eligibility.rules.is_eligible, skips households already paid for cycle 2 (idempotency key household_id:2), disburses 60 dollars via payments.vouchers.disburse (no hand-built payment IDs), queues a PAYMENT_SENT SMS wrapped in try/except (ValueError, RuntimeError) so SMS being disabled or sms_ok=False never aborts the payment loop, uses config.settings.now() for the clock, and prints a summary with counts and receipts.total_paid(). P2: ran the script once — 25 eligible households paid 60 dollars each, 30 skipped as ineligible, 1 SMS not queued (consent/feature off), total paid overall 2820 dollars. Also wrote and ran scripts/verify_cycle2.py, which confirms exactly 25 cycle-2 payments, each eligible household paid exactly once at 60 dollars, and no ineligible household paid.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
